message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code reads data via initialize_training_data/initialize_test_data from local files; no remote fetch with checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions is present.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no label distribution comparison, label value validation against an expected set, or any label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) used anywhere in the data preparation flow.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed on the dataset before it is passed to the trainers.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads checkpoints via `get_latest_checkpoint` and `compile_model(latest_checkpoint=...)` but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed before loading the weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection are performed before or during training in any of the visible code.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is imported or applied anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any stress-testing routines are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model outputs (e.g., NaN guards, probability bounds, or sanity thresholds) are visible in any of the inference/prediction code paths shown.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a sensor-based neural network for orientation/position estimation, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
